name: Maximilian Gruber
bio:
Maximilian's fascination with electronics began dismantling and reassembling radios as a child in the Austrian Alps. He formally studied electrical engineering at the Vienna University of Technology, quickly developing a passion for high-performance applications, particularly in motorsport. After graduating, he spent several years honing his skills at a small, independent racing team specializing in historic Formula cars before joining Nostalgia Racing. 

Maximilian approaches his work with meticulous precision and a deep understanding of the intricate relationship between electronic systems and vehicle performance. His knack for troubleshooting complex issues and his dedication to finding innovative solutions make him a valuable asset to the team. He thrives on the challenge of optimizing electronic systems to gain a competitive edge, always seeking ways to extract maximum performance from the available technology.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Maximilian is a lean man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool, even to meetings.
Has a habit of humming quietly while concentrating on complex problems.
Insists on organizing his workspace with extreme precision.
